decision.reason: I could not verify this finding because the entire working directory is unreadable by my tools, so I have no basis for a grounded refutation. Read on packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts failed with "File does not exist"; Grep for getUsedBounds|expandUnbounded|buildDependantsMap returned no files; Glob for **/yorkie-store.ts, packages/*/package.json, *, and **/* returned no files; and a catch-all Grep for "." also returned nothing. Crucially, Read also failed for packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts and the root package.json — files that indisputably exist per the authoritative changed-file list. So the empty results reflect a staging/tooling failure, not absence of code, and cannot support a not-present refutation without circular reasoning. No guard could be cited (already-guarded), the issue is squarely in the test-adequacy lane so it is not out-of-scope, and pre-existing is ruled out because yorkie-store.ts is in the PR's changed-file list. The finding is at least internally consistent with that list: yorkie-store.ts was modified while the only touched test files (coordinates.test.ts, formula/formula.test.ts, sheet/calculation.test.ts) all live in the sheets package, none under packages/frontend, matching the claim that the collaborative-store path lacks coverage. Under this lens a clear behavior change with no meaningful test is major, and per the instruction that uncertainty keeps the finding, I confirm with low confidence.
